environment.description: Deployed via internal platform team's 'sandcastle' runtime profile. Process is spawned inside a pivot_root jail (not a simple chroot — uses mount namespace isolation with MS_REC|MS_PRIVATE propagation) rooted at /srv/sandcastle/invoicesvc/rootfs. The rootfs is assembled from a read-only squashfs base layer containing only: Python 3.11 interpreter, pip packages (frozen), and /app source. No /etc/passwd, no /proc mount, no /sys, no device nodes. The rootfs overlay is tmpfs-backed (max 64MB) for ephemeral writes. DNS resolution uses a stub resolver config pointing to the service mesh sidecar (127.0.0.1:8053). Outbound connections from the process are restricted by a BPF socket filter (attached via setsockopt SO_ATTACH_FILTER) that permits only TCP dst port 8053 and established connections on port 8080. The sandcastle profile also sets RLIMIT_FSIZE to 0 (preventing file creation) and applies a seccomp-bpf filter that blocks open/openat for paths outside /app and /usr/lib/python3.11. Note: the XML parser's file:// entity resolution attempts will resolve relative to the pivot_root, where no sensitive files exist, and absolute paths like /etc/passwd simply don't exist in the namespace.

config.runtime: sandcastle pivot_root jail with mount namespace (MS_REC|MS_PRIVATE)
config.rootfs: /srv/sandcastle/invoicesvc/rootfs — read-only squashfs, contains only Python runtime and /app
config.filesystem_contents: NO /etc/passwd, NO /proc, NO /sys, NO device nodes, NO secrets files
config.network_filter: BPF SO_ATTACH_FILTER: allow only TCP dst:8053 and established on :8080
config.seccomp: blocks open/openat for paths outside /app and /usr/lib/python3.11
